# NY State of Politics

> > A comprehensive regional news hub covering New York politics and multi-state coverage across the United States through Spectrum News networks.

NY State of Politics is part of the Spectrum News network, providing local and regional political coverage with a focus on New York state affairs while maintaining connections to national news stories. The site serves as a navigation portal for accessing news content across multiple states and regions.

## Key Topics

- New York politics
- Spectrum News
- Regional news hub
- Multi-state coverage
- Capital Region
- Local news
- News portal
- Spectrum Noticias
- US news coverage
- Community engagement
- Story tips
- Newsroom
- Spanish-language news
- Regional navigation
- News submission

## News Hub & Navigation

- [Spectrum News](https://nystateofpolitics.com/splash.html): Spectrum News multi-state regional news hub covering NY, NC, FL, TX, CA and more
- [Spectrum News Regional Portal](https://nystateofpolitics.com/splash): Spectrum News regional navigation portal with multi-state local news coverage
